notes.title: First Month in Review
notes.content:
Steamers,

The first month since the release of ATHOPS has come and gone in the blink of an eye.  ATHOPS has sold in 45 countries around the world and has had many unique players.  Thank you all for supporting this game!

Without the players like yourselves to spread the word and give me feedback, the game would not have evolved into its current state.  29 Steam Achievements have been added... it was fun to do and they've been well received - and best yet, they are functional and players are starting to gobble them up.  

If you were an early ATHOPS player PRE-ACHIEVEMENTS, reach out to me and let me know!  I can now retroactively fix that, and reward you for your early efforts!

Thank you all so much for the support and the reviews!  Continue to spread the word so others can help Make Astoria Great Again!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29708309/023defc5f9114fc7885814df6ae0da2908d514db.png[/img]

Luke
Golden Unicorn Gaming

notes.title: Astoria: The Holders of Power Saga has been RELEASED!
notes.content:
Steamers,

I'm very proud to officially present Astoria: The Holders of Power Saga!

ATHOPS is a story based RPG containing intrigue, betrayal, love, tons of in-game dialogue, hundreds of equipment, items, and spells, and many hidden secrets.  Over 35 hours of gameplay in a world with an intricate storyline and memorable characters, where battle is slightly more strategic and more difficult than the average RPG.  If you like epic fantasy-styled RPGs similar to Dragon Warrior, Phantasy Star, and Lufia, give ATHOPS a shot! 

Thanks for your interest!

Golden Unicorn Gaming

notes.title: The Countdown Til Release!
notes.content:
Fellow Steamers,

It is with great pleasure that Astoria: The Holders of Power Saga, has finally made its way onto the Store Page on Steam.  This has been a four year labor of love!  Over these next two weeks, myself, playtesters, and Kickstarter Backers and testers will be finalizing our runs through the game so that in August when ATHOPS finally gets released, it is as polished as possible.  I really hope you give this game a try, and until then, happy gaming!

- Golden Unicorn Gaming
